q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an umbrella?
title: Umbrella carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the steel or fibreglass frame, shaft, canopy fabric and handle per umbrella with supplier figures. Add cutting, stitching, assembly and packing energy, then divide the unit's energy by umbrellas packed.
audience: Umbrella makers and assemblers in Kerala and elsewhere

ul: Steel or fibreglass ribs and shaft.
Plastic or wooden handle, runner and tips.

p: Report per umbrella by type, folding or straight, since the folding frame has more parts.

example.title: Worked example: umbrella unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 3,550 / 40,000 = 0.0887 kg CO2 per piece
Add frame, fabric and handle for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
